title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 476 East Main Street in Galesburg, Illinois, as the Senior Airman Daniel Miller Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 476 East Main Street in Galesburg, Illinois, as the "Senior Airman Daniel Miller Post Office Building."

summary.headline: A law renaming the Galesburg, Illinois post office at 476 East Main Street after Senior Airman Daniel Miller.
summary.what_it_does: The law officially names the U.S. Postal Service building at 476 East Main Street in Galesburg, Illinois, the "Senior Airman Daniel Miller Post Office Building." It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail rules, or anything else about how the office operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021, when it was signed.
